returns.desc: Cookie value, decoded; a JSON cookie is parsed into its Object or Array; Returns null if cookie not found
Object with cookie names (as keys) and their values, decoded and parsed as get() returns them

value.desc: Cookie value; an Object or Array is stored as JSON and parsed back by get(); anything else reads back as a String

expires.desc: Cookie expires detail; If specified as Number, then the unit is days; If specified as String, it can either be raw stringified date or in Xd Xh Xm Xs format (see examples)

other.desc: Raw string for other cookie options; To be used as a last resort for possible newer props that are currently not yet implemented in Quasar

options.desc: Cookie options; a cookie is removed only by a write carrying the same path and domain it was set with, and a __Secure- or __Host- prefixed one needs secure as well

other.desc: Raw string for other cookie options; To be used as a last resort for possible newer props that are currently not yet implemented in Quasar

useCookie.desc: Get a Vue ref bound to a cookie: it reads the cookie value (the default, or null, while missing), assigning it stores the value (null removes the cookie, or resets it to the default) and a nested change of an Object or Array value gets stored too. It follows the changes made through set()/remove(), through other refs of the same cookie and, where the browser has the Cookie Store API, those made by the server or another tab/window. It is released together with the calling scope (a component, a Pinia store, an effectScope()); outside of one, call its stop() method when done

options.desc: Ref options, followed by the cookie options every write from the ref uses (see set())

default.desc: Returns the value the ref reads while the cookie is missing; called when the ref is created and each time the ref takes the default again (a null assignment, a removal), so that an Object or Array default is a fresh one every time; the value gets stored when the ref attaches to a missing cookie (on the client only) and again whenever the cookie is removed

deep.desc: Hand out an Object or Array value reactive, so that a nested change gets tracked and persisted; set it to false for a value that you only ever assign as a whole

disabled.desc: While true the ref is detached from the cookie (a plain in-memory ref); once false again it attaches like a new ref: the stored value wins if the cookie exists, otherwise the current value gets stored

expires.desc: Cookie expires detail; If specified as Number, then the unit is days; If specified as String, it can either be raw stringified date or in Xd Xh Xm Xs format (see examples)

other.desc: Raw string for other cookie options; To be used as a last resort for possible newer props that are currently not yet implemented in Quasar

returns.desc: A Vue ref with an extra stop() method that detaches it from the cookie

parseSSR.desc: For SSR/SSG usage only, and only on the global import (not on $q.cookies)

returns.desc: Cookie object (like $q.cookies) for SSR/SSG usage purposes
